title: test(dogfood): pin five more api-backend checklist items at their oracle's layer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VsCYkn9rw8Z1i5vq5MHxL4)_
Refs #26572 (slice 2 of about 3, items: packaged-action-disabled-dispatch, action-activation-door-contract, rest-crud-config-contract, rest-batch-config-contract, rest-metadata-config-contract)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 api-backend 清单里又 5 个被 18.2.0 Tier 1 扫描判为 PARTIAL 的条目补钉子：动作停用与激活门在真实 HTTP、MCP 和冷重启上验证，三个 REST 配置契约的默认挂载在启动的服务上验证、非默认配置在真实 RestServer 上验证；并更新这 5 条的 automated.ref、verify、revision 和 history。
- 为什么改：这些条款的判据在 HTTP 层或真实 RestServer 上，旧钉子只到单元层或根本没有，每次发版扫描都要人工补跑；现在变成常驻、可重跑的证明。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试、一个 scratch fixture 和清单文本，不改任何产品代码；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。dogfood 只在 main 的定时/推送批次跑，不进 PR 和合并队列。
- 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts`（MCP 与冷重启）、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/rest-config-contract-harness.test.ts`（真实 RestServer 的路由表与缓存分支）、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/rest-config-contract-harness.test.ts`，预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Five more api-backend checklist items that the release-18.2.0 Tier 1 sweep (#26468) scored PARTIAL now carry pins at the layer their oracle names. The `api` legs drive a booted stack through `@objectstack/verify`'s real HTTP surface (Hono request injection), plus the live MCP transport and a cold boot on one database file. The `test` legs construct a real `RestServer`, which is the method the three config items prescribe because no shipped boot path authors a `RestServerConfig` (the #15543 posture).

| Item | Clauses pinned | Pin |
|---|---|---|
| `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` | acceptance[0]–[6], negative[0]–[2]: exact 409 `ACTION_DISABLED` and sentence with the task re-read unchanged, the param-gallery 409/400 ordering pair, the byte-identical 403s, a live `POST /api/v1/mcp` `run_action` refusal carrying the REST door's exact message, the flow-type action's own switch, the anonymous 401, and the cold-boot durability leg | `packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts` (new) |
| `api-backend.action-activation-door-contract` | acceptance[0]–[6], negative[0]–[2]: authority before body and lookup, the 2-/4-segment shapes against the routing-404 control, the `fields[0]` codes, `{}` enabling, zero ledger rows after refusals, exactly one row updated in place, and the ambiguity arm live | `action-activation-door-live.dogfood.test.ts` + `fixtures/activation-ambiguity-fixture.ts` (new) |
| `api-backend.rest-crud-config-contract` | acceptance[0] (six default mounts vs the control), [2] (live `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` body vs the control, and the switched-off route absent), [3] (the whole table re-based at `dataPrefix: '/records'`), [4] (both tombstones' schema and prescription) | `rest-config-contract-live.dogfood.test.ts`, `rest-config-contract-harness.test.ts` (new) |
| `api-backend.rest-batch-config-contract` | acceptance[0] (four bulk doors and `/batch` vs the control), [4] (201 records → 400 `BATCH_TOO_LARGE` max 200, nothing created), [5] (both tombstones' schema and replacement) | same two files |
| `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract` | acceptance[0] (default `/meta` mounts vs the control), [1] (whole table re-based at `prefix: '/metadata'`), [3] (the `client_liaison` member's served `showcase_project` schema omits budget, spent and budget_remaining), [4] (`enableCache` and each of its carve-outs), [5] (both tombstones' schema and replacement) | same two files |

Each item's `automated.ref` names the new pins and what they assert. The verify texts that said "unit only" or "no pin" now name the pin that carries the clause, `revision` is bumped and a `history` row cites #26572. `action-activation-door-contract`'s `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` gains one sentence saying the colliding scratch package now exists. No clause text changed. No product code changed.

## Why

The card's ruled scope (triage 6437722483) is to pin the 11 api-backend Tier 1 clauses the 18.2.0 sweep scored PARTIAL at the layer their oracle names. The pins go in `packages/qa/dogfood/**`, with the checklist item revisions bumped, in slices of about five items, and with no new CI lane. Slice 1 landed as #26787. This is slice 2, the next five items in card order. `rest-route-generation-tombstones` is left for slice 3.

## Tests

The touched test files on head 14a3213a (after merging `main` and rebuilding the dogfood closure), under the verify lock:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/rest-config-contract-harness.test.ts test/rest-config-contract-live.dogfood.test.ts test/action-activation-door-live.dogfood.test.ts test/packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts
 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  29 passed (29)
```

Every expectation was first measured against the live answer on a probe boot, then checked against the clause text before it was written down. No ablation was run: the diff changes no tested behaviour, it only adds pins over behaviour that already holds.

## Acceptance notes

- Dogfood runs only in `main`'s scheduled and push battery (`Dogfood Regression Gate`'s `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`), so the PR's CI does not run these files. The local run above is their evidence until the next `main` battery.
- The harness file imports `RestServer` through `@objectstack/runtime`'s re-export. `@objectstack/rest` is not a dogfood dependency, and adding one would move `pnpm-lock.yaml`, which is outside this card's file surface.
- The MCP leg composes `MCPServerPlugin` the way `showcase-mcp-http-identity.dogfood.test.ts` does. `showcase_portfolio_snapshot` is the only stock `ai.exposed` action, so the MCP refusal is read on it, and the REST door's message for the same action is compared byte for byte.
- The cold-boot leg stops the stack and boots it again on the same `databaseFile`, the shape `automation-authoring-doors-durable.dogfood.test.ts` uses.
- The ambiguity fixture declares `actamb_archive` inside two objects' own `actions`. The door refuses from either object, names both, writes no row, and the action still dispatches afterwards.
- Still not covered, as the items already record: the activation door's metadata-plane 503 and its 501/503 durability arms (no stock door).

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates (dispatch-gates --commands, reconciled with --ran)</summary>

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0, `OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.
- 55 derived commands at 37105b78 (measured on the identical tree before its message was reworded): 54 exit 0; 1 exit 3 (prerequisite not met, nothing measured): `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which reads built output of packages outside the dogfood closure. It runs in CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- After merging `main` (0ea90c7a), the derived list is unchanged. The gates whose scripts the merge moved, plus the checklist gate, were re-run on the merge head: `check-closing-keyword-parity` (and `--self-test`), `check:platform-checklist`, `check-issue-citations`, all exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood run typecheck`: exit 0.
- eslint over the five touched TypeScript files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 55 derived families accounted for, 54 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun.

</details>

No changeset: `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint over the touched files)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (nothing publishes)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
